sentences.en: The approaches used in those two designs are exactly alike.
sentences.zh: 这两个设计所采用的方法完全一样。

sentences.en: I mistook her for Minako. They look so much alike.
sentences.zh: 我错把她当成了美奈子。她们长得太像了。

sentences.en: Adults and children alike would like to see the movie.
sentences.zh: 大人和小孩都喜欢看这部电影。

senses.zh: 十分相像地，很相似地；两者都，同样地；同等对待地，一视同仁地
